prompt: Describe a responsibility, your contribution, and what you learned.
requirements:
Describe your responsibility.
Explain what you learned.
essay: After school I cared for my younger brother while our mother worked. I prepared dinner, helped him practice reading, and kept a shared calendar so I could finish my own assignments. At first I tried to solve every homework question for him. When I started asking him to explain his reasoning, he began working more independently. I learned that being helpful sometimes means giving someone time to work through a problem. Now I plan our evening around his questions rather than my answers.
activities: Family care, approximately ten hours weekly.
